name: Clean Body
overview: Scripture reveals that a clean body is both a physical and spiritual reality rooted in obedience to God's commands and the cleansing power of His word. God promises protection from disease for those who diligently follow His statutes (Exodus 15:26), while the psalmist expresses a desire for purification that surpasses mere outward washing (Psalms 51:7). Jesus teaches that true cleanliness comes through His word (John 15:3), and believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God (Romans 12:1). Ultimately, this purity is connected to the gift of eternal life through Christ, contrasting the death earned by sin (Romans 6:23).
